info.description: Vehicle identity and intelligence data — VIN decode, market value, listings, depreciation, reports, listing history, photos, specifications, recalls, and ownership costs — plus the account, API-key, and billing control plane. Data endpoints authenticate with a product API key (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`); control-plane endpoints use a dashboard session token. Errors are RFC 9457 application/problem+json, and every response carries an x-request-id header.
